# Label

Figma: `Label`, node `58:919` (page Components, `1:28`).
6 variants - `property 1[6]`: text, icon + text, Variant5, Multi person, status, person.

A read-only field: a small caption above a value.

## All six variants are one shape

Every variant is a caption above a slot, 4px apart. Only the slot's contents change:

| Variant | Slot holds | Verified |
|---|---|---|
| text | plain text | `58:918` |
| status | a [Tag](Tags.md) | `58:917` |
| person | an Avatar compact | `58:916` |
| icon + text | text with a glyph | - |
| Multi person | a [Multi avatar](MultiAvatar.md) | - |
| Variant5 | auto-generated name | - |

So this is a caption and a slot, not six variants. `Variant5` is another of Figma's
auto-generated names - FINDINGS.md #15.

## Markup

Plain text:

```html
<div class="v27-label">
  <span class="v27-label__caption">Text label</span>
  <span class="v27-label__value">Label content</span>
</div>
```

With a status tag - compose, do not restyle:

```html
<div class="v27-label">
  <span class="v27-label__caption">Status</span>
  <span class="v27-tag v27-tag--info">Info</span>
</div>
```

With a person:

```html
<div class="v27-label">
  <span class="v27-label__caption">Name</span>
  <span class="v27-avatar-compact">
    <span class="v27-avatar-compact__face"><img src="/p.jpg" alt="" /></span>
    Jane Smith
  </span>
</div>
```

## Classes

| Class | What it is |
|---|---|
| `.v27-label` | the column |
| `.v27-label__caption` | Sm, `Foreground/Secondary` |
| `.v27-label__value` | Base, `Foreground/Primary` - the default slot content |

## Values

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| gap | `--v27-spacing-xs` (4px) |
| caption | Sm - Outfit 14 / 400 / 16 |
| value | Base - Outfit 16 / 400 / 20 |

# Avatar compact

Figma: standalone symbol `Avatar compact`, node `289:4416`. Not a variant set; measured as
an instance inside Label (`58:916`).

A 24px face beside a name.

```html
<span class="v27-avatar-compact">
  <span class="v27-avatar-compact__face"><img src="/p.jpg" alt="" /></span>
  Avatar compact
</span>
```

| Class | What it is |
|---|---|
| `.v27-avatar-compact` | the row, 8px gap, Base text |
| `.v27-avatar-compact__face` | the 24px face |

Like [Multi avatar](MultiAvatar.md)'s, the face here is the `People` symbol with a 46px
radius - **not** the [Avatar](Avatar.md) component, which is 29px with a themed background
and a `Border/Default` ring. `.v27-avatar` is deliberately not reused.

That makes three different circular-face treatments in the library. Worth consolidating in
Figma; reproduced as measured until it is.

## All classes in this component

`.v27-label`, `.v27-label__caption`, `.v27-label__value`
